traits.name: Giant Ancestry
traits.description: You are descended from giants. Choose one ancestry from the Giant Ancestries table. You gain the benefit of that ancestry. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

traits.name: Large Form
traits.description: Starting at character level 5, you can change your size to Large as a Bonus Action. This transformation lasts for 10 minutes, until you die, or until you revert to your normal size as a Bonus Action. While Large, you have Advantage on Strength checks, and your Speed increases by 10 feet. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest.

traits.name: Powerful Build
traits.description: You count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift.
